senses.gloss: f. (רָצַח) case of murder, capital case, capital execution.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 35a:10">Snh. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ר׳ דוחה שבת</he> capital punishment does not supersede the Sabbath (v. <cite ref="D00397"><he>דָּחָה</he></cite>). Mekh. Mishp. s. 4 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 21:14">Ex. XXI, 14</cite>) <he>ללמדך על ר׳ שדוחה וכ׳</he> to intimate that the execution of a culprit supersedes the Temple service; a. fr.
